content_sections.heading: NABFINS Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: NABFINS has announced an opportunity for the post of Customer Service Officer, Customer Service Executive . The number of vacancies has not been specified in the details provided for this recruitment.

content_sections.heading: NABFINS Customer Service Officer Job Role
content_sections.text: The primary responsibility of a Customer Service Officer is to source customers and increase the sustainable portfolio of the branch . The CSO has to identify new business locations, source potential customers and support their addition to the branch portfolio. After disbursement, the employee is also responsible for following up with customers and collecting installments on scheduled dates.

content_sections.heading: Responsibilities
content_sections.text: The key responsibilities of a NABFINS Customer Service Officer include: Sourcing of clients. Primary verification of client credentials. Conducting Compulsory Group Training. Data entry in CRIF. Data entry in CMS. Accompanying the Branch Manager for Group Recognition Test. Accompanying CSE during pre-disbursement activities. Ensuring disbursement. Generating demand. Following up for recovery and undertaking collections. Remitting collections in the bank or banks. Reporting demand and collection details to ABM/BM. Maintaining and filing documents.

content_sections.heading: NABFINS Customer Service Executive Responsibilities
content_sections.text: Sourcing and acquiring new customers. Expertise in end-to-end management of Processing Individual Business Loans (IBL) and Affordable Housing Loans (AHL). Conducting field visits and customer meetings. Collecting KYC and income-related documents. Assisting to BH for Credit appraisal processing and disbursement. Maintaining customer relationships and providing Post Disbursement support. Coordinating with Credit Teams. Supporting collection and portfolio quality management. Ensuring compliance with company policies and regulatory guidelines. Interested candidates can share your CV for the below mentioned mail ID.

content_sections.heading: NABFINS Customer Service Officer Location
content_sections.text: Karnataka Tamil Nadu Madhya Pradesh Gujarat

content_sections.heading: NABFINS Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for the NABFINS Customer Service Officer Recruitment 2026 must meet the prescribed educational, language and field mobility requirements. The minimum educational qualification is: PUC/10+2 completed. Candidates who have completed Higher Secondary or an equivalent 10+2 qualification can apply, subject to the other eligibility requirements. Applicants must have written, spoken and reading command over the local language and English . This requirement is important because the role involves regular interaction with customers, branch staff and field-level operations. Freshers are eligible to apply for the Customer Service Officer post. However, candidates with 1 to 3 years of experience in a similar job profile and sufficient exposure to field operations and the target customer population may be preferred. A valid driving licence and motorcycle are mandatory for the Customer Service Officer role. The job involves field visits, identifying new business locations, customer sourcing, collection and other branch-related field activities. Graduate in any discipline (10+2+3) Min 2 years experience in sourcing, processing, and servicing Business Loans and Affordable Housing Loans with Banks, NBFCs, MFIs, or Housing Finance Companies (HFCs) preferred. Good communication and interpersonal skills. Willingness to travel locally for field visits. Knowledge of local language is mandatory.

content_sections.heading: NABFINS Customer Service Officer Important Dates 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates should send their application before 01 September 2026 and avoid waiting until the last day.

content_sections.heading: NABFINS Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: The detailed selection process has not been specified in the information provided. Candidates who submit their resume may be shortlisted by NABFINS based on eligibility, educational qualification, experience, field suitability and other requirements of the Customer Service Officer role. Shortlisted candidates should follow further instructions communicated by NABFINS regarding the next stages of recruitment.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NABFINS Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Check the NABFINS Customer Service Officer eligibility criteria. Prepare an updated resume containing educational qualification and work experience details. Ensure that your mobile number and email address are correctly mentioned in the resume. Attach the updated resume to the email. Use a clear subject line such as Application for Customer Service Officer (CSO), Customer Service Executive (CSE) Send the application to [email protected] . Complete the application process on or before 01 September 2026 .

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for NABFINS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply for NABFINS CSO and CSE Recruitment 2026 is 01 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. Which posts are available under NABFINS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: NABFINS Limited is inviting applications for Customer Service Officer (CSO) and Customer Service Executive (CSE) posts.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for NABFINS Customer Service Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates who have completed PUC/10+2 or equivalent are eligible to apply for the Customer Service Officer post, subject to other requirements.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for NABFINS Customer Service Executive Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Customer Service Executive post should have a Graduate degree in any discipline (10+2+3).

faq.question: Q5. Can freshers apply for NABFINS CSO Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Yes. Freshers are eligible to apply for the Customer Service Officer post. Candidates with 1 to 3 years of relevant field experience may be preferred.

faq.question: Q6. Is experience required for the NABFINS Customer Service Executive post?
faq.answer: For the CSE post, candidates with a minimum of 2 years of experience in sourcing, processing and servicing Business Loans or Affordable Housing Loans with Banks, NBFCs, MFIs or HFCs are preferred.

faq.question: Q7. Is a driving licence required for NABFINS CSO Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates applying for the Customer Service Officer post must have a valid driving licence and a motorcycle, as the job involves regular field visits.
